entry.initial: Limit selected; More collapsed; remembered advanced entry TP/SL Limit. Available before authentication or explicit private context read.
entry.supported: Six ordinary opening modes map to existing ordinary/conditional/trailing submit/review flow. Scaled opens existing independent route/review/journal.
entry.unavailable: Chase and TWAP visible with localized unavailable reasons and disabled selection; never fallback to LIMIT or simulate successful submission. Chase lacks documented recovery/associated order query; TWAP user-deferred.
entry.memory: Screen-session only; advanced choice changes remembered More label, choosing basic leaves remembered advanced choice. Cancel/refresh/locale preserve; id/address/walletKind/signingAvailable change resets Limit/Stop Limit. No durable preference or new financial configuration write.
entry.closing: Dedicated position close and position triggers keep their specialized original selectors and mandatory review; Scaled/opening menu omitted.
entry.defaults: Blank raw amounts/quote unit, initial valid Last limit, Mark conditional/trailing, empty trigger/rate/activation, protection off and existing GTC defaults remain. Post Only pins GTX and disables changing its timeInForce; absent refreshed GTX support blocks review until explicitly selecting another mode.
entry.drafts: Switching keeps existing shared/raw inputs and dormant optional values; inactive trigger/limit/trailing/attachment fields excluded by existing draft rules. Initial empty defaults do not silently overwrite an edited draft. Explicit leaving Post Only selects new mode's GTC default; existing non-Post policies survive market round trips.
entry.locks: Mode/Scaled selection rechecks mounted, live busy/unknown result, settings ownership/recovery and auth busy. Menu-list virtualization does not discard result while owner screen remains live; disposed/locked owner ignores stale callback.
entry.transport: No new API/nonce/signature/submit implementation. Choosing entry never reads a private account, signs, creates wallet or submits. Current EOA or existing embedded wallet is retained.

architecture.domain: Typed product modes, protocol-independent classification; separate strategy entries never treated as ordinary types.
architecture.presentation: Localized wrapping basic chips and scrollable safe-area More sheet; no orientation lock, literal colors, HTTP clients or financial doubles. Existing long screen/form builds reviewed: selector and price/trigger/trailing components separate; stateful form remains under400lines, no transport added.

coverage: EN/ZH320width text1.5,844x390landscape and768tablet; six opening modes each selected before private read, defaults, independent review then exact synthetic type/quantity/policy/basis assertions.
Signed-out all9 entries, both disabled choices cannot navigate, Scaled route opens with zero private reads/submits/wallet creation.
Refresh/menu cancel/locale preserve selected and remembered; same-address identity type change resets.
Captured callback while read pending cannot change mode/open Scaled; recycled selector still returns choice; disposed owner safely ignores callback.

Existing ordinary/close/TP/SL/Trailing/BBO/Scaled/amount/confirmation/unknown-result scenarios choose actual replacement opening menu. Original financial parameter and recovery assertions retained; fixed GTX unsupported path now explicitly switches mode rather than mutating fixed policy.

remaining: Main opening percentage slider/sizing and some BBO/default settings remain incomplete; ordinary custom slippage lacks execution contract.
Chase not implemented: original strategy-ID recovery and associated ordinary order query not documented. TWAP remains user-deferred.
Full strategy list/edit/whole cancellation, full cross-product Portfolio and Swap incomplete.
Real EOA self-signer acceptance, signatures, execution, native layouts/storage/wallet returns and iOS build unverified; device testing deferred.
